utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ve got Dane and Nora at 8:15, and I’ll handle them. Tess can keep Rey posted if anything changes, and Sam will grab Mina.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I can fill Dane in and lend a hand if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus — that helps. I’ll stick to 8:15 for Dane and Nora unless I hear otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, I’m in the carpool at 8:15. Ira will text when they’re on the way, and Bo can handle the other days.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great — I’ll keep the plan aligned, and Vik can pass it along to the carpool group so everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good — thanks, Jules. That should keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m just checking the carpool time before I confirm it to Kira. Once it’s set, Vik can pass the plan along to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great — once you’ve got the exact time and stop list, send them my way and I’ll check my schedule and the route. If Rey can help too, that should make it easier.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, I’ll verify the exact time and stop list with Faye, then I’ll send them over. Jules can help keep it clear for everyone, and I’ll let Vik share the final plan once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ll pass along the pickup time as soon as I hear it, and I’m keeping my phone handy.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Nell — if you hear back, could you repeat the time for Oren too? I’m still happy to help on some weekdays around 7:30 to 8:00 a.m. and 3:00 to 3:30 p.m.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely — I’ll repeat it for Oren too as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I'll cover the other days and keep an eye out for your text when you're on the way.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect — I can take Tuesdays and Thursdays, and I’ll text you when I’m on my way.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — that works for me.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll note 3:15, check the pickup time with Nell, and let you know. Faye stays on the carpool list, and Rey can help if we need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll send the carpool schedule and loop Eli in if anyone else wants a ride. Then Pia can check her schedule and route once I share the details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good — I’ll confirm 3:15 with Nell and keep the rider list sorted.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: The carpool is still set for 8:00 a.m. at the church parking lot, and I’ll text everyone the plan.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll be ready for Eli to pick up me and Nora.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — thanks, Dane. I’ll keep everyone posted, and we’re still set for 8:00 a.m. at the church parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep, the carpool is still at 8:15. I’ll keep picking up Mina.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it—I’ll pass the carpool plan along to everyone. Rosa can send the pickup spot and time once it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good—once Rosa confirms the pickup spot, I’ll stick with 8:15 and keep getting Mina.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — so we meet at 8:00 a.m. in the church parking lot, and Ira handles Tuesdays and Thursdays?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, that sounds right — 8:00 a.m. at the church lot, and Ira has Tuesdays and Thursdays. I can text Oren the time again if you want.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, please text Oren the time again. And Rosa can send the full plan to everyone, right?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Rosa’s still confirming the pickup spot and time, and Jules is helping coordinate our 8:15 carpool. I’ll keep an eye out for the final details.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Opal — keep me posted on the final spot and time, and I can help with the carpool if needed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do — I’ll pass along the pickup spot and time as soon as Rosa confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 3:15 still works for me. Just let me know right away if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll let you know right away if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks. I’ll plan on 3:15 and keep the pickup after school on Monday and Wednesday in mind.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still at 8:15, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, still 8:15 at the church parking lot. I’ll keep Rey posted too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks — 8:15 at the church lot, got it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: The carpool’s still on for tomorrow, and I’m keeping the rider groups organized. If we need extra help, Rey can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I can fill Dane in on the carpool and lend a hand. It’s still set for 8:15, so we’re good.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks, Gus — I’ve got the groups lined up, and I’ll keep an eye on the list in case we need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can take Tuesdays and Thursdays for the carpool, and Bo can cover the other days. The 8:15 carpool for Mina and Opal is set.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I can help if you need another hand, and Quinn will send the schedule and loop Eli in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — that helps a lot. Hana can confirm the time to Kira, and we’re all set with the 8:15 carpool.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Rosa is still confirming the pickup spot and time, and Jules is helping with the 8:15 carpool for Mina and me. Mara can also help on some weekdays around 7:30 to 8:00 a.m. and 3:00 to 3:30 p.m.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 3:15 still works for me, and I’m happy to do pickup after school on Monday and Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — Monday and Wednesday pickup after school works for me. I’ll wait on Rosa’s final pickup spot and time, and keep the 8:15 carpool with Jules in mind.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s still set for 8:15 at the church parking lot, and I’ll keep Rey posted too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s 8:00, not 8:15, right? And can you have Vik pass the plan along and make sure Ira texts when he’s on the way?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s 8:15 at the church parking lot, and I can ask Vik to pass the plan along. I’ll stick with the current carpool note and keep Rey posted.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the carpool if you need me to.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That would be great — I’ll send the carpool schedule and loop Eli in too in case anyone else needs a ride.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — keep me posted on the schedule and any changes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll wait for Eli to pick me and Nora up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, sounds good — the carpool’s at 8:15, and Cleo’s handling the list and rider groups. I’ll keep Rey posted too.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, that works for me — I’ll be ready at 8:15.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’ll keep an eye out for any updates and pass them along. Sounds like Gus can fill Dane in if needed for the 8:15 carpool.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yep, 7:30 still works for me. Cleo was going to check the pickup time and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Okay, thanks — I’ll wait for Cleo’s update on the pickup time and keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — Oren’s in the carpool and he’ll send the rider groups, and Cleo’s handling the list and will be ready when they come through.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still at 8:15, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, 8:15 still works.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ve got the pickup details from Faye, and once the plan is set Vik can pass it along to everyone. If needed, Jules can help make it clear and Gus can fill Dane in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Right now the carpool is at 8:15, and I’ll keep picking Mina up. Eli has Dane and Nora covered, and Faye handles after-school pickup on Monday and Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’m noting 8:15, your Mina pickup, Eli covering Dane and Nora, and Faye on Monday and Wednesday after-school pickup. Once it’s finalized, Vik can share it with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — Vik can pass the plan along to the carpool group so everyone’s on the same page. I can help coordinate too if needed.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great — weekdays are around 7:30 to 8:00 a.m. and 3:00 to 3:30 p.m., and Oren asked to have the time repeated so he can keep track. Uli can make 7:30, and Sam is picking Mina up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll help keep it coordinated, and Vik can repeat the weekday times to the group so Oren has them too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: 7:30 sounds good for me too. Thanks, Pia.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, then we’re set for 7:30. I’ll wait for the pickup confirmation and make sure the rest gets passed along.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Pia. I’ll send the pickup confirmation along.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik — I’ve got the plan set for 8:00 a.m. at the church parking lot, and I’ll text everyone to keep it clear.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, I’ll pass that along to everyone. 8:00 a.m. at the church parking lot it is.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thanks, Vik — that should keep everyone on the same page.
